|lore=Adventurous pilot. Boasts to Jabba that he has traveled to every uncharted planet in the galaxy. Has been hired by the Empire to keep an eye out for Rebel activity.
|game_text=If opponent just initiated a Force drain at a non-shielded planet location, deploy on that location. Your characters, vehicles and starships may deploy here regardless of presence and location deployment restrictions. (Immune to Control.)

|rulings=* This does ''not'' circumvent restrictions listed on an Objective (even if the Objective references limiting deployment at certain locations).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Cane%20Adiss</ref>
* This does ''not'' circumvent text on a card that says it only deploys if a certain Objective on table.
* This does ''not'' circumvent rules or text that certain cards cannot ''exist'' at certain locations (e.g. no starfighters at [[Tatooine: Cantina (Dark){{!}}Cantina]] or [[Endor: Dense Forest (Dark){{!}}Endor: Dense Forest]]).
* This does ''not'' circumvent deployment restriction text that is entirely unrelated to locations (e.g. [[Emperor's Orders]] or [[Revenge Of The Sith]]).
* Allows cards to deploy regardless of presence or Force icons.
* Allows cards to deploy to [[Dagobah (Dark){{!}}Dagobah]] or [[Ahch-To]].
* Allows cards to deploy regardless of their own game text saying they can only deploy to certain locations.
* Allows cards to deploy regardless of game text on other cards (except Objectives) saying certain cards may not deploy to certain locations.
* If deployed on a non-shielded location (e.g. [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (Dark){{!}}Hoth: Defensive Perimeter]]) and then that location becomes shielded later, [[Cane Adiss]] remains there and will allow cards to deploy there regardless of the shield.
